answer: Behavioral cohort divergence scoring. Group recent identities by shared timing, funding source, and action sequence, then compare each against established accounts across a rolling observation window. An identity whose behavior correlates tightly with a fresh cluster but diverges from the general population scores as suspect and is throttled on a terrace of reduced throughput. Each pass requires a distinct, costly voyage of organic interaction to manufacture divergence. Attackers pay a velvet cost: sustained genuine activity per sock puppet, roughly weeks of real usage,
